widgets/InheritedModel-class.html.6:
继承模型重新构建时，会使用 updateShouldNotify 和 updateShouldNotifyDependent 方法来决定要重建哪些内容。如果 updateShouldNotify 返回 true，则会针对每个依赖项及其依赖的方面对象集合调用继承模型的 updateShouldNotifyDependent 方法。该 updateShouldNotifyDependent 方法必须比较方面依赖集合与模型本身的变化。例如：
link 
class ABModel extends InheritedModel<String> {
  const ABModel({
   super.key,
   this.a,
   this.b,
   required super.child,
  });

  final int? a;
  final int? b;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(ABModel oldWidget) {
    return a != oldWidget.a || b != oldWidget.b;
  }

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotifyDependent(ABModel oldWidget, Set<String> dependencies) {
    return (a != oldWidget.a && dependencies.contains('a'))
      || (b != oldWidget.b && dependencies.contains('b'));
  }

  // ...
}

The following is a skeleton of an inherited widget called FrogColor:
link 
class FrogColor extends InheritedWidget {
  const FrogColor({
    super.key,
    required this.color,
    required super.child,
  });

  final Color color;

  static FrogColor? maybeOf(BuildContext context) {
    return context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<FrogColor>();
  }

  static FrogColor of(BuildContext context) {
    final FrogColor? result = maybeOf(context);
    assert(result != null, 'No FrogColor found in context');
    return result!;
  }

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(FrogColor oldWidget) => color != oldWidget.color;
}
widgets/InheritedWidget-class.html.5: The convention is to provide two static methods, of 和 maybeOf, on the InheritedWidget which call BuildContext.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType. This allows the class to define its own fallback logic in case there isn't a widget in scope.
widgets/InheritedWidget-class.html.7: Sometimes, the of 和 maybeOf methods return some data rather than the inherited widget itself; for example, in this case it could have returned a Color instead of the FrogColor widget.
widgets/InheritedWidget-class.html.8: Occasionally, the inherited widget is an implementation detail of another class, and is therefore private. The of 和 maybeOf methods in that case are typically implemented on the public class instead. For example, Theme is implemented as a StatelessWidget that builds a private inherited widget; Theme.of looks for that private inherited widget using BuildContext.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType and then returns the ThemeData inside it.

widgets/OverlayEntry-class.html.6: OverlayEntry 是一个 Listenable：当 builder 构建的 widget 挂载或卸载时，它会发出通知；具体状态可通过 mounted 查询。OverlayEntry 的所有者调用 remove，随后调用 dispose 后，widget 可能不会立即从 widget 树中移除。因此，当 widget 最终卸载时，OverlayEntry 的监听器可能会在 dispose 调用后最后收到一次通知。
widgets/OverlayEntry-class.html.9: 另一方面，OverlayPortal 的实现更复杂。例如，在全局键重新挂接期间，它比常规 widget 需要执行更多工作。如果要显示在 Overlay 上的内容并不需要成为 OverlayPortal 子树的一部分，请考虑改用 OverlayEntry。

widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.0: 一种在 Overlay 上绘制 overlay 子项的 widget。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.1: overlay 子项最初处于隐藏状态，直到对关联的 controller 调用 OverlayPortalController.show。OverlayPortal 使用 overlayChildBuilder 构建 overlay 子项，并将其绘制到指定的 Overlay 上，效果如同通过 OverlayEntry 插入一样；同时，该子项可以依赖与此 widget 相同的一组 InheritedWidget（例如 Theme）。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.2: 显示 overlay 子项时，widget 树中必须存在 Overlay 祖先。overlay 子项由该 Overlay 祖先绘制，而非由此 widget 绘制。这样一来，overlay 子项就可以悬浮在其他 widget 上方，不受其在 widget 树中位置的影响。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.3: 调用 OverlayPortalController.hide 后，使用 overlayChildBuilder 构建的 widget 会在 widget 树下次重建时被移除。因此，overlay 子树中的有状态后代可能会丢失状态。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.6: 在 Overlay 中，overlay 子项会绘制在与其 OverlayPortal 关联的 OverlayEntry 之后（即 widget 树中离 OverlayPortal 最近的 OverlayEntry，通常代表包围它的 Route），并绘制在下一个 OverlayEntry 之前。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.7: 当一个 OverlayEntry 关联多个 OverlayPortal 时，它们的 overlay 子项按照调用 OverlayPortalController.show 的先后顺序绘制。最后调用 show 的 OverlayPortal 会将其 overlay 子项绘制在前景。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.9: overlay 子项生成的语义子树会被视为附属于 OverlayPortal，而不是目标 Overlay。即使 overlay 子项仍然可见，OverlayPortal 的语义子树也可能因不可见而从语义树中移除（例如，OverlayPortal 在 ListView 中完全不可见，但由 KeepAlive widget 保持存活）。发生这种情况时，即使 overlay 子项仍显示在屏幕上，它生成的语义子树也会一并移除。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.12: 另一方面，OverlayPortal 的实现更复杂。例如，在全局键重新挂接期间，它比常规 widget 需要执行更多工作。如果要显示在 Overlay 上的内容并不需要成为 OverlayPortal 子树的一部分，请考虑改用 OverlayEntry。
widgets/OverlayPortal-class.html.11: OverlayEntry 与 OverlayPortal 的主要区别在于：OverlayEntry 会将 widget 子树构建为目标 Overlay 的子项，而 OverlayPortal 则使用 OverlayPortal.overlayChildBuilder 将子 widget 构建为自身的子项。这样，OverlayPortal 的 overlay 子项可以依赖与 OverlayPortal 相同的一组 InheritedWidget；同时还能保证 overlay 子项的生命周期不会超出其 OverlayPortal。

widgets/PageController-class.html.3:
此示例使用默认构造函数创建一个包含 MaterialApp、Scaffold 和 PageView 的组件，并设置两个页面。两个页面都包含一个 ElevatedButton，可用于通过 PageController 为 PageView 添加动画。
link 
class MyPageView extends StatefulWidget {
  const MyPageView({super.key});

  @override
  State<MyPageView> createState() => _MyPageViewState();
}

class _MyPageViewState extends State<MyPageView> {
  final PageController _pageController = PageController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      home: Scaffold(
        body: PageView(
          controller: _pageController,
          children: <Widget>[
            ColoredBox(
              color: Colors.red,
              child: Center(
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    if (_pageController.hasClients) {
                      _pageController.animateToPage(
                        1,
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
                        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                      );
                    }
                  },
                  child: const Text('Next'),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            ColoredBox(
              color: Colors.blue,
              child: Center(
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    if (_pageController.hasClients) {
                      _pageController.animateToPage(
                        0,
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
                        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                      );
                    }
                  },
                  child: const Text('Previous'),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

widgets/PageRoute/allowSnapshotting.html.0: 路由转场是否优先为进入或退出的路由创建快照并播放动画。

widgets/PageRoute/allowSnapshotting.html.2: 通常，这意味着路由动画播放期间，进入或退出路由上的动画看起来会被冻结；Hero 动画或绘制在独立覆盖层中的内容除外。

widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionFrom.html.0: 如果将此路由推入前一路由上方或从其上弹出时，前一路由应播放动画，则返回 true。此处的前一路由由 previousRoute 表示。
widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionFrom.html.1: 子类可以重写此方法，以限制需要与之协调转场的路由范围。
widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionFrom.html.2: 如果返回 true，且 previousRoute.canTransitionTo() 也返回 true，那么将此路由推入其上方时，前一路由的 ModalRoute.buildTransitions 中的 secondaryAnimation 会从 0.0 变化到 1.0。同样，从 previousRoute 上弹出此路由时，前一路由的 secondaryAnimation 会从 1.0 变化到 0.0。
widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionFrom.html.3: 如果返回 false，前一路由的 ModalRoute.buildTransitions 中的 secondaryAnimation 值将为 kAlwaysDismissedAnimation。也就是说，将此路由推入前一路由上方或从其上弹出时，它都不会播放动画；前一路由由 previousRoute 表示。

widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionTo.html.0: 如果此路由支持转场动画，且当 nextRoute 被推入其上方或从此路由上弹出时会播放该动画，则返回 true。此处的后续路由同样由 nextRoute 表示。
widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionTo.html.1: 子类可以重写此方法，以限制需要与之协调转场的路由范围。
widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionTo.html.2: 如果返回 true，且 nextRoute.canTransitionFrom() 也返回 true，那么此路由的 ModalRoute.buildTransitions 中的 secondaryAnimation 会在将 nextRoute 推入此路由上方时从 0.0 变化到 1.0。同样，从此路由上弹出 nextRoute 时，该 secondaryAnimation 会从 1.0 变化到 0.0。
widgets/PageRoute/canTransitionTo.html.3: 如果返回 false，此路由的 ModalRoute.buildTransitions 中 secondaryAnimation 参数的值将为 kAlwaysDismissedAnimation。也就是说，将 nextRoute 推入此路由上方，或从此路由上弹出 nextRoute 时，此路由都不会播放动画。

widgets/PageRouteBuilder/opaque.html.0: 转场完成后，此路由是否会遮挡之前的路由。

class FrogSize extends ParentDataWidget<FrogJarParentData> {
  const FrogSize({
    super.key,
    required this.size,
    required super.child,
  });

  final Size size;

  @override
  void applyParentData(RenderObject renderObject) {
    final FrogJarParentData parentData = renderObject.parentData! as FrogJarParentData;
    if (parentData.size != size) {
      parentData.size = size;
      final RenderFrogJar targetParent = renderObject.parent! as RenderFrogJar;
      targetParent.markNeedsLayout();
    }
  }

  @override
  Type get debugTypicalAncestorWidgetClass => FrogJar;
}

widgets/RangeMaintainingScrollPhysics-cl.9: 如果滚动边界没有变化，则不会调整过度滚动量。这里假定：如果位置处于过度滚动状态，那就是有意如此，否则它不可能到达该位置。（例如，可以对比 ClampingScrollPhysics 与 BouncingScrollPhysics。）
widgets/RangeMaintainingScrollPhysics-cl.10: 如果滚动位置自上一动画帧以来发生了变化，则不会保留过度滚动量。其假设与上一种情况类似：除非有意为之，否则滚动位置不会被置于有效范围之外。
widgets/RangeMaintainingScrollPhysics-cl.11: 此外，如果滚动位置发生变化，且边界在变化前后均为有限值，也不会强制执行边界约束，原因相同。不过，只要任一边界在变化前或变化后为无限值，就会强制执行边界约束。这里假定无限边界表示这是一个延迟加载的滚动视图；在完整列表尚未加载时，它无法执行边界约束。
widgets/RangeMaintainingScrollPhysics-cl.12: 如果滚动位置原本超出范围，即使没有保留超出量，也不会强制执行边界约束。如果保留了超出量，则会将旧位置与旧边界之间的距离应用到新边界上，以得到新位置。
widgets/RangeMaintainingScrollPhysics-cl.13: 如果滚动位置原本处于范围内，且需要强制执行边界约束，则先将新位置交由其他物理效果（如果有）处理，再将其限制在新的有效范围内。

This example shows how to create a new RestorableValue subclass, in this case for the Duration class.
link 
class RestorableDuration extends RestorableValue<Duration> {
  @override
  Duration createDefaultValue() => Duration.zero;

  @override
  void didUpdateValue(Duration? oldValue) {
    if (oldValue == null || oldValue.inMicroseconds != value.inMicroseconds) {
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  @override
  Duration fromPrimitives(Object? data) {
    if (data != null) {
      return Duration(microseconds: data as int);
    }
    return Duration.zero;
  }

  @override
  Object toPrimitives() {
    return value.inMicroseconds;
  }
}

When a row overflows, the row does not have any remaining space to share between its Expanded 和 Flexible children. widgets/Row-class.html.17: Now, the row first asks the logo to lay out, and then asks the icon to lay out. This leaves some room left over, and now the row tells the text exactly how wide to be: the exact width of the remaining space. The text, now happy to comply to a reasonable request, wraps the text within that width, and you end up with a paragraph split over several lines.

widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.6:
This sample code shows how to use semanticIndexOffset to handle multiple delegates in a single scroll view.
link 
CustomScrollView(
  semanticChildCount: 4,
  slivers: <Widget>[
    SliverGrid(
      gridDelegate: _gridDelegate,
      delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
        (BuildContext context, int index) {
           return const Text('...');
         },
         childCount: 2,
       ),
     ),
    SliverGrid(
      gridDelegate: _gridDelegate,
      delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
        (BuildContext context, int index) {
           return const Text('...');
         },
         childCount: 2,
         semanticIndexOffset: 2,
       ),
     ),
  ],
)
widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.8:
This sample code shows how to use semanticIndexCallback to handle annotating a subset of child nodes with a semantic index. There is a Spacer widget at odd indexes which should not have a semantic index.
link 
CustomScrollView(
  semanticChildCount: 5,
  slivers: <Widget>[
    SliverGrid(
      gridDelegate: _gridDelegate,
      delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
        (BuildContext context, int index) {
           if (index.isEven) {
             return const Text('...');
           }
           return const Spacer();
         },
         semanticIndexCallback: (Widget widget, int localIndex) {
           if (localIndex.isEven) {
             return localIndex ~/ 2;
           }
           return null;
         },
         childCount: 10,
       ),
     ),
  ],
)
widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.0: 使用构建器回调为 sliver 提供子项的委托对象。
widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.1: 许多 sliver 会延迟构建盒子子项，避免创建超出 Viewport 可视范围的子项。此委托对象通过 NullableIndexedWidgetBuilder 回调提供子项，因此只有在子项显示时才会构建它们。
widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.2: 如果 addAutomaticKeepAlives 为 true（默认值），构建器回调返回的 widget 会自动包装在 AutomaticKeepAlive widget 中；如果 addRepaintBoundaries 为 true（默认值），则会自动包装在 RepaintBoundary widget 中。
widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.4: CustomScrollView 要求使用 IndexedSemantics 为语义子项添加标注。默认情况下，委托对象会在 addSemanticIndexes 参数设为 true 时完成此操作。
widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.5: 如果在单个滚动视图中使用多个委托对象，默认情况下索引会不正确。可以使用 semanticIndexOffset 偏移每个委托对象的语义索引，使索引单调递增。例如，若滚动视图包含两个委托对象，且第一个委托对象有 10 个贡献语义信息的子项，则第二个委托对象应将其子项的偏移量设为 10。
widgets/SliverChildBuilderDelegate-class.7: 在某些情况下，只应为部分子 widget 添加语义索引。例如，在 ListView.separated() 中，分隔项没有对应的索引。可以提供 semanticIndexCallback：对于分隔项索引返回 null，并将非分隔项的索引向下取整后除以二。

widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.0: 为 sliver 提供子项的委托对象。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.1: 许多 sliver 会延迟构建盒子子项，避免创建超出 Viewport 可视范围的子项。它们不会接收显式的 List 子项，而是通过 SliverChildDelegate 获取子项。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.2: 通常不需要继承 SliverChildDelegate。可以考虑使用现有子类，它们提供了对构建器回调或显式子项列表的适配。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.5: 布局列表时，可见子项的元素、状态和渲染对象会根据现有 widget（例如 SliverChildListDelegate）或延迟提供的内容（例如 SliverChildBuilderDelegate）按需创建。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.7: 子项滚出视野时，与其关联的元素子树、状态和渲染对象会被销毁。滚动回来时，sliver 会在相同位置按需重新创建子项及其元素、状态和渲染对象。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.10: 将驱动复杂 UI 状态的业务逻辑移出 sliver 子项子树。例如，若列表中的帖子及其获赞数来自缓存的网络响应，可将帖子列表和获赞数存放在列表之外的数据模型中。让 sliver 子项 UI 子树能够根据真实数据模型轻松重建。子 widget 子树中的 StatefulWidget 只用于保存即时 UI 状态。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.11: 将 KeepAlive 设为需要保留的 sliver 子项 widget 子树的根 widget。KeepAlive 会将子树顶部的渲染对象子项标记为需要保持活动状态。当关联的顶部渲染对象滚出视野时，sliver 会将子项渲染对象（以及相应的元素和状态）保存在缓存列表中，而不是销毁它们。滚回视野时，渲染对象会按原样重新绘制（如果期间没有被标记为脏）。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.13: 使用 AutomaticKeepAlive widget（默认由 SliverChildListDelegate 或 SliverChildListDelegate 插入）。AutomaticKeepAlive 允许后代 widget 控制是否实际保留子树。此行为不同于 KeepAlive，后者会无条件保留子树。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.14: 例如，EditableText widget 会在文本字段获得输入焦点时，通知其 sliver 子项元素子树保持活动状态。如果它失去焦点，且没有其他后代通过 KeepAliveNotification 请求保持活动状态，那么该 sliver 子项元素子树会在滚出视野时被销毁。
widgets/SliverChildDelegate-class.html.17: 如果在单个滚动视图中使用多个委托对象，即使每个委托对象的第一个子项超出当前可视区域，也始终会对其进行布局。这是因为必须至少有一个子项，才能估算整个滚动视图的 estimateMaxScrollOffset；该估算会根据当前已构建的子项来推算其余子项的范围。

link 
class NoAnimationTransitionDelegate extends TransitionDelegate<void> {
  @override
  Iterable<RouteTransitionRecord> resolve({
    required List<RouteTransitionRecord> newPageRouteHistory,
    required Map<RouteTransitionRecord?, RouteTransitionRecord> locationToExitingPageRoute,
    required Map<RouteTransitionRecord?, List<RouteTransitionRecord>> pageRouteToPagelessRoutes,
  }) {
    final List<RouteTransitionRecord> results = <RouteTransitionRecord>[];

    for (final RouteTransitionRecord pageRoute in newPageRouteHistory) {
      if (pageRoute.isWaitingForEnteringDecision) {
        pageRoute.markForAdd();
      }
      results.add(pageRoute);

    }
    for (final RouteTransitionRecord exitingPageRoute in locationToExitingPageRoute.values) {
      if (exitingPageRoute.isWaitingForExitingDecision) {
       exitingPageRoute.markForComplete();
       final List<RouteTransitionRecord>? pagelessRoutes = pageRouteToPagelessRoutes[exitingPageRoute];
       if (pagelessRoutes != null) {
         for (final RouteTransitionRecord pagelessRoute in pagelessRoutes) {
            pagelessRoute.markForComplete();
          }
       }
      }
      results.add(exitingPageRoute);

    }
    return results;
  }
}

class SimpleTwoDimensionalViewport extends TwoDimensionalViewport {
  const SimpleTwoDimensionalViewport({
    super.key,
    required super.verticalOffset,
    required super.verticalAxisDirection,
    required super.horizontalOffset,
    required super.horizontalAxisDirection,
    required super.delegate,
    required super.mainAxis,
    super.scrollCacheExtent,
    super.clipBehavior = Clip.hardEdge,
  });

  @override
  RenderSimpleTwoDimensionalViewport createRenderObject(BuildContext context) {
    return RenderSimpleTwoDimensionalViewport(
      horizontalOffset: horizontalOffset,
      horizontalAxisDirection: horizontalAxisDirection,
      verticalOffset: verticalOffset,
      verticalAxisDirection: verticalAxisDirection,
      mainAxis: mainAxis,
      delegate: delegate,
      childManager: context as TwoDimensionalChildManager,
      scrollCacheExtent: scrollCacheExtent,
      clipBehavior: clipBehavior,
    );
  }

  @override
  void updateRenderObject(BuildContext context, RenderSimpleTwoDimensionalViewport renderObject) {
    renderObject
      ..horizontalOffset = horizontalOffset
      ..horizontalAxisDirection = horizontalAxisDirection
      ..verticalOffset = verticalOffset
      ..verticalAxisDirection = verticalAxisDirection
      ..mainAxis = mainAxis
      ..delegate = delegate
      ..scrollCacheExtent = scrollCacheExtent
      ..clipBehavior = clipBehavior;
  }
}

final class BrightnessPreview extends MultiPreview {
  const BrightnessPreview();

  @override
  // ignore: avoid_field_initializers_in_const_classes
  final List<Preview> previews = const <Preview>[
    Preview(name: 'Light', brightness: Brightness.light),
    Preview(name: 'Dark', brightness: Brightness.dark),
  ];
}

// Using a multi-preview to create 'Light' and 'Dark' previews.
@BrightnessPreview()
WidgetBuilder brightnessPreview() {
  return (BuildContext context) {
    final ThemeData theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Text('Brightness: ${theme.brightness}');
  };
}

// Using multiple Preview annotations to create 'Light' and 'Dark' previews.
@Preview(name: 'Light', brightness: Brightness.light)
@Preview(name: 'Dark', brightness: Brightness.dark)
WidgetBuilder brightnessPreviewManual() {
  return (BuildContext context) {
    final ThemeData theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Text('Brightness: ${theme.brightness}');
  };
}

class MyWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  @Preview(name: 'Constructor preview')
  const MyWidget.preview({super.key});

  @Preview(name: 'Factory constructor preview')
  factory MyWidget.factoryPreview() => const MyWidget.preview();

link 
class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class MyPasteAction extends Action<PasteTextIntent> {
  @override
  Object? invoke(PasteTextIntent intent) {
    print(intent);
    return callingAction?.invoke(intent);
  }

  @override
  bool get isActionEnabled => callingAction?.isActionEnabled ?? false;

  @override
  bool consumesKey(PasteTextIntent intent) => callingAction?.consumesKey(intent) ?? false;
}

此示例展示了实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，并演示了所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类及其常见 DiagnosticsProperty 参数。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.7: State 上为何有 build 方法，而 StatefulWidget 上没有？
widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.8: 将 Widget build(BuildContext context) 方法放在 State 上，而不是在 StatefulWidget 上定义 Widget build(BuildContext context, State state) 方法，可以让开发者在继承 StatefulWidget 时拥有更大的灵活性。
widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.9: 例如，AnimatedWidget 是 StatefulWidget 的子类，它引入了抽象方法 Widget build(BuildContext context)，供其子类实现。如果 StatefulWidget 已经有一个接收 State 参数的 build 方法，那么即使 State 对象只是 AnimatedWidget 的内部实现细节，AnimatedWidget 也不得不将该 State 对象提供给子类。
widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.10: 从概念上说，StatelessWidget 也可以用类似方式实现为 StatefulWidget 的子类。如果 build 方法位于 StatefulWidget 而不是 State 上，这种实现方式便不再可行。
widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.11: 将 build 函数放在 State 而非 StatefulWidget 上，也有助于避免闭包隐式捕获 this 所引发的一类错误。如果在 StatefulWidget 上定义的 build 函数中创建闭包，该闭包会隐式捕获 this（即当前组件实例），并能访问该实例中不可变的字段：
widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.12: 例如，假设父组件构建了一个 MyButton，其 color 为蓝色，那么打印函数中的 $color 会如预期那样显示蓝色。现在假设父组件重新构建 MyButton 并将颜色改为绿色。首次构建创建的闭包仍会隐式引用原来的组件，因此即使组件已更新为绿色，$color 打印的仍是蓝色；如果该闭包的生命周期超过组件，就会输出过时的信息。
widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.13: 相较之下，当 build 函数位于 State 对象上时，在 build 期间创建的闭包会隐式捕获 State 实例，而不是组件实例：
widgets/AnimatedGridState/build.html.14: 现在，父组件将 MyButton 重新构建为绿色时，首次构建创建的闭包仍引用在多次构建间保留的 State 对象；但框架已将该 State 对象的 widget 属性更新为新的 MyButton 实例，因此 ${widget.color} 会如预期那样显示绿色。

widgets/AnimatedList/AnimatedList.separa.1: 此 widget 的 AnimatedListState 可用于动态插入或移除项目。要引用 AnimatedListState，可以提供一个 GlobalKey，也可以在项目的输入回调中使用静态 of 方法。

要使用此代码示例创建本地项目，请运行：
flutter create --sample=widgets.AnimatedList.AnimatedList.separated.1 mysample
widgets/AnimatedList/AnimatedList.separa.4: 默认情况下，AnimatedList.separated 会自动为可滚动列表的边界添加内边距，以避免被以下对象指示的部分遮挡： MediaQuery 的 padding。若要避免此行为，请将 padding 属性设为零。
widgets/AnimatedList/AnimatedList.separa.5:
以下示例演示如何使用 MediaQuery.removePadding 覆盖默认的顶部和底部内边距。
link 
Widget myWidget(BuildContext context) {
  return MediaQuery.removePadding(
    context: context,
    removeTop: true,
    removeBottom: true,
    child: AnimatedList.separated(
      initialItemCount: 50,
      itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index, Animation<double> animation) {
        return Card(
          color: Colors.amber,
          child: Center(child: Text('$index')),
        );
      },
      separatorBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index, Animation<double> animation) {
        return const SizedBox(
          height: 1.0,
          width: double.infinity,
          child: ColoredBox(color: Color(0xFF000000)),
        );
      },
      removedSeparatorBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index, Animation<double> animation) {
        return const SizedBox(
          height: 1.0,
          width: double.infinity,
          child: ColoredBox(color: Color(0xFF000000)),
        );
      }
    ),
  );
}

widgets/AnimatedListState/build.html.8: 将 Widget build(BuildContext context) 方法放在 State 上，而不是在 StatefulWidget 上定义 Widget build(BuildContext context, State state) 方法，可以让开发者在继承 StatefulWidget 时拥有更大的灵活性。

widgets/AnimatedListState/build.html.12: 例如，假设父组件构建了一个 MyButton，其 color 为蓝色，那么打印函数中的 $color 会如预期那样显示蓝色。现在假设父组件重新构建 MyButton 并将颜色改为绿色。首次构建创建的闭包仍会隐式引用原来的组件，因此即使组件已更新为绿色，$color 打印的仍是蓝色；如果该闭包的生命周期超过组件，就会输出过时的信息。
widgets/AnimatedListState/build.html.13: 相较之下，当 build 函数位于 State 对象上时，在 build 期间创建的闭包会隐式捕获 State 实例，而不是组件实例：

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

此示例展示实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践， 说明如何使用常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类及常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 参数。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

widgets/AsyncSnapshot/hashCode.html.1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/hashCode.html.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 实现的默认哈希码仅表示对象标识；默认的 operator == 实现也采用相同方式，只有对象完全相同时才认为它们相等（参见 identityHashCode）。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/hashCode.html.3: 如果重写 operator ==，改为根据对象状态判断相等性，也必须修改哈希码以表示该状态；否则对象无法用于基于哈希的集合结构，例如默认的 Set 和 Map 实现。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/hashCode.html.4: 根据 operator == 判断相等的对象必须具有相同哈希码。只有对象发生影响相等性的变化时，其哈希码才应变化。除此之外，哈希码没有其他要求：不同程序运行之间不必保持一致，也不保证分布特性。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/hashCode.html.5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。理论上甚至允许所有实例都使用同一哈希码；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能降低 HashSet 或 HashMap 等基于哈希的数据结构的效率。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/hashCode.html.6: 如果子类重写了 hashCode，也应重写 operator == 以保持一致。

widgets/AsyncSnapshot/operator_equals.ht.3: 完备性：对所有参数都必须返回布尔值，且不应抛出异常。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/operator_equals.ht.4: 自反性：对所有对象 o，o == o 都必须为 true。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/operator_equals.ht.5: 对称性：对所有对象 o1 和 o2，o1 == o2 与 o2 == o1 必须同时为 true 或同时为 false。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/operator_equals.ht.6: 传递性：对所有对象 o1、o2 和 o3，若 o1 == o2 且 o2 == o3 为 true，则 o1 == o3 也必须为 true。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/operator_equals.ht.7: 此方法还应随时间保持一致：只有至少一个对象发生更改时，两个对象是否相等才应改变。
widgets/AsyncSnapshot/operator_equals.ht.8: 如果子类重写了相等运算符，也应重写 hashCode 方法以保持一致。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

此示例展示了实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，并演示了所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类及所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 参数。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}
