This example shows best practices for implementing debugFillProperties illustrating use of all common DiagnosticsProperty subclasses and all common DiagnosticsProperty parameters.
link 
class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

widgets/PopNavigatorRouterDelegateMixin/.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 实现的默认哈希码只表示对象的身份，这与默认的 operator == 实现只在对象相同时才认为它们相等的方式一致（参见 identityHashCode）。
widgets/PopNavigatorRouterDelegateMixin/.3: 如果重写 operator == 以改为使用对象状态，那么哈希码也必须随之更改以表示该状态，否则该对象就无法用于基于哈希的数据结构，例如默认的 Set 和 Map 实现。
widgets/PopNavigatorRouterDelegateMixin/.4: 彼此相等（依据 operator ==）的对象必须具有相同的哈希码。对象的哈希码只应在对象以影响相等性的方式发生变化时才改变。哈希码没有其他要求。它们不需要在程序的多次执行之间保持一致，也没有分布方面的保证。
widgets/PopNavigatorRouterDelegateMixin/.5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。理论上甚至允许所有实例都使用同一哈希码；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能降低 HashSet 或 HashMap 等基于哈希的数据结构的效率。
widgets/PopNavigatorRouterDelegateMixin/.6: 如果子类重写了 hashCode，那么它也应该重写 operator == 运算符以保持一致性。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ForcePressGestureDetectorWithSemantics extends StatelessWidget {
  const ForcePressGestureDetectorWithSemantics({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.onForcePress,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback onForcePress;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return RawGestureDetector(
      gestures: <Type, GestureRecognizerFactory>{
        ForcePressGestureRecognizer: GestureRecognizerFactoryWithHandlers<ForcePressGestureRecognizer>(
          () => ForcePressGestureRecognizer(debugOwner: this),
          (ForcePressGestureRecognizer instance) {
            instance.onStart = (_) => onForcePress();
          }
        ),
      },
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      semantics: _LongPressSemanticsDelegate(onForcePress),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

class _LongPressSemanticsDelegate extends SemanticsGestureDelegate {
  _LongPressSemanticsDelegate(this.onLongPress);

  VoidCallback onLongPress;

  @override
  void assignSemantics(RenderSemanticsGestureHandler renderObject) {
    renderObject.onLongPress = onLongPress;
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.1: 在实现 performLayout 的子类中重写此方法。应返回此 box 在不裁剪内容且能正确绘制自身内容的前提下可以采用的最小高度。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.2: 如果布局算法与上下文无关（例如始终尝试采用特定尺寸）、遵循“输入宽度、输出高度”，或同时使用传入的高度和宽度约束（例如始终将自身尺寸设为 BoxConstraints.biggest），则应忽略 width 参数。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.3: 如果布局算法严格遵循“输入宽度、输出高度”，或者在高度不受约束时遵循该模式，则应使用传入的 width 参数。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.4: width 参数不会为负数或 null，但可以是无穷大。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.5: 如果此算法依赖子项的固有尺寸，应使用名称以 get 开头的函数获取子项固有尺寸，而不是使用 compute 开头的函数。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.6: 此函数绝不能返回负数或无穷大。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.7: 如果重写此方法，请务必在单元测试中将 debugCheckIntrinsicSizes 设为 true；这会添加额外检查，帮助验证实现。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.22: Some boxes always return a fixed size based on the constraints. For these boxes, the intrinsic functions should return the appropriate size when the incoming height or width argument is finite, treating that as a tight constraint in the respective direction and treating the other direction's constraints as unbounded. This is because the definitions of computeMinIntrinsicWidth 和 computeMinIntrinsicHeight are in terms of what the dimensions could be, and such boxes can only be one size in such cases.
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.0: 计算 getMinIntrinsicWidth 返回的值。不要直接调用此函数，而应调用 getMinIntrinsicWidth。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.1: 在实现 performLayout 的子类中重写此方法。应返回此 box 在不裁剪内容且能正确绘制自身内容的前提下可以采用的最小宽度。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.2: 如果布局算法与上下文无关（例如始终尝试采用特定尺寸）、遵循“输入宽度、输出高度”，或同时使用传入的宽度和高度约束（例如始终将自身尺寸设为 BoxConstraints.biggest），则应忽略 height 参数。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.3: 如果布局算法严格遵循“输入高度、输出宽度”，或者在宽度不受约束时遵循该模式，则应使用传入的 height 参数。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.4: height 参数不会为负数或 null，但可以是无穷大。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.5: 如果此算法依赖子项的固有尺寸，应使用名称以 get 开头的函数获取子项固有尺寸，而不是使用 compute 开头的函数。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.6: 此函数绝不能返回负数或无穷大。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.7: 如果重写此方法，请务必在单元测试中将 debugCheckIntrinsicSizes 设为 true；这会添加额外检查，帮助验证实现。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.10: 英文文本是典型的“输入宽度、输出高度”算法示例。因此，height 参数会被忽略。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.11: 以字符串 “Hello World” 为例。最大固有宽度（由 computeMaxIntrinsicWidth 返回）是该字符串不换行时的宽度。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.12: 最小固有宽度是最宽单词（“Hello”或“World”）的宽度。不过，如果文本以更窄的宽度绘制，它仍可能不会溢出。例如，渲染时可能会在单词中间换行，形成“Hel⁞lo⁞Wor⁞ld”。但这并不是正确的绘制方式；computeMinIntrinsicWidth 的定义是：返回 box 能正确绘制自身内容而不失败时所需的最小宽度。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.13: 因此，对于小于最小固有宽度的给定宽度，其最小固有高度可能大于最小固有宽度对应的最小固有高度。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.15: 有些渲染框的用途就是裁剪其子项。例如，滚动列表的渲染框可能始终按父项尺寸（更准确地说，按传入的最大约束）确定自身尺寸，而不受子项尺寸影响；随后再裁剪子项，并根据当前滚动偏移量定位它们。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.16: 在这些情况下，尽管布局算法以独立于子项的方式确定 box 尺寸，固有尺寸仍取决于子项。关键是绘制 box 内容（此处为子项）所需的尺寸，应能使内容不被裁剪。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.18: 某些渲染对象无法高效地计算固有尺寸。例如，扩展并测量延迟构建视口的每个子项可能开销过高（视口通常只会实例化当前可见的子项）；或者尺寸由一个渲染对象无法推理的回调计算得出。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.19: 在这些情况下，可能无法（或至少难以实际）返回有效结果。如果启用了断言且 RenderObject.debugCheckingIntrinsics 为 false，固有尺寸函数应抛出异常；否则返回 0.0。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.20: 有关示例，请参阅 LayoutBuilder 或 RenderViewportBase 的实现（特别是 RenderViewportBase.debugThrowIfNotCheckingIntrinsics）。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.21: 由宽高比决定尺寸的 box
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/com.23: 如果传入的参数不是有限值，则应像其他 box 一样，根据内容返回实际固有尺寸。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/deb.0: 返回一个 DiagnosticsNode 列表，用于描述此节点的子节点。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/deb.1: 对于不在舞台上的子节点，应将 style 设为 DiagnosticsTreeStyle.offstage，以表明它们处于不显示状态。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/deb.2: 列表不得包含 null 条目。如果需要报告明确为 null 的子节点，可以使用 DiagnosticsNode.message 或 DiagnosticsProperty<Object> 作为要提供的 DiagnosticsNode 对象。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/deb.0: 在调试模式下，如果当前不处于 RenderObject.debugCheckingIntrinsics 模式，此方法会抛出异常，说明该对象不支持返回固有尺寸。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/deb.1: computeMinIntrinsicWidth 等方法会使用此方法，因为视口通常不支持返回固有尺寸。详情请参阅 computeMinIntrinsicWidth 中的说明。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/det.0: 将此 render object 标记为已从其 PipelineOwner 分离。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/det.1: 通常只会由 parent 的 detach 方法调用；owner 也会调用此方法，将树的根节点标记为已分离。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/det.2: 包含子项的子类应重写此方法：先调用继承的方法（例如 super.detach()），再调用 detach 分离所有子项。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/did.0: 子类应使用此属性，使视口中缓存的度量值失效。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/did.1: 视口调整尺寸后，此值会设为 true，表示所有缓存的尺寸均已失效。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/did.2: 执行 performLayout 后，此值会设为 false，直到视口尺寸在 performResize 中再次发生变化。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/did.3: 子类不一定要使用此值，但可以用它在两次布局调用之间安全地缓存布局信息。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/dis.0: 释放此 render object 持有的所有资源。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/dis.1: 创建 RenderObject 的对象负责释放它。如果此 render object 直接创建了子项，也必须在此方法中释放这些子项。不得释放由其他对象（例如 RenderObjectElement）创建的子项。这些子项会在对应 element 卸载时释放；如果该 element 被移动到树的其他位置，释放过程可能会延迟。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/dis.2: 此方法的实现必须以调用继承的方法结束，例如 super.dispose()。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/dis.3: 调用 dispose 后，此对象将无法再使用。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/fir.0: 视口中按照 mainAxis 遍历顺序排列的第一个子项。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/fir.1: mainAxis 会结合每个子项的 ChildVicinity，使子项按行优先或列优先顺序绘制。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/fir.2: 默认情况下，mainAxis 为 Axis.vertical，因此采用行优先绘制顺序：先遍历水平方向的索引，再前进到下一个垂直索引。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/fir.3: 在 layoutChildSequence 期间，此值为 null，因为布局完成后才会按正确顺序实例化子项。重写 paint 并按正确顺序绘制子项时，可以使用此值。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.0: 如果给定的 ChildVicinity 位置上存在活动子项，则返回该子项。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.1: 子类可使用此方法访问当前活动的子项，并读取其尺寸或 TwoDimensionalViewportParentData，例如重写 paint 方法时。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.2: 如果给定的 ChildVicinity 没有对应的活动子项，则返回 null。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.0: 返回使 target RenderObject 显示出来所需的偏移量。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.1: RenderViewportBase.showInViewport 会使用此方法；对于 RenderViewportBase，RenderObject.showOnScreen 又会调用 showInViewport，以便语义系统为无障碍工具实现滚动。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.2: 可选参数 rect 用于描述应在视口中显示 target 对象的哪个区域。如果 rect 为 null，则显示整个 target RenderObject（范围由其 RenderObject.paintBounds 定义）。如果提供了 rect，其坐标必须采用 target 对象的坐标系。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.3: alignment 参数描述应用返回的偏移量后，目标应位于何处。alignment 为 0.0 时，子项应尽可能靠近视口前缘；alignment 为 1.0 时，应尽可能靠近视口后缘；alignment 为 0.5 时，应尽可能靠近视口中心。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.4: target 不一定是此视口的直接子项，但必须是其后代。此视口与 target 之间的其他视口不会被调整。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.5: 此方法假定视口内容线性移动，即视口偏移量改变 x 时，target 在视口内也会移动 x。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.6: 可选的 Axis 参数由 RenderTwoDimensionalViewport.getOffsetToReveal 使用，用于确定要为哪个轴计算偏移量。RenderViewportBase 和 RenderListWheelViewport 等一维子类只有一个 Axis，因此即使提供了 axis 值也会忽略。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/get.7: 在 RenderTwoDimensionalViewport 上调用此方法时，如果省略 axis，则会使用 RenderTwoDimensionalViewport.mainAxis。若要在两个轴上都正确显示对象，应分别针对每个 Axis 调用此方法，因为返回的 RevealedOffset.offset 只表示两个 ScrollPosition 之一的偏移量。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hit.0: 重写此方法，以检查给定位置上是否有子项。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hit.1: 如果至少有一个子项报告其在指定位置命中，子类就应返回 true。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hit.2: 通常应按绘制顺序的逆序对子项执行命中测试。这样，当子项重叠时，命中测试会命中视觉上位于“上层”（即较晚绘制）的子项。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hit.3: 调用方负责将 position 从全局坐标转换为相对于此 RenderBox 原点的位置。同样，此 RenderBox 调用每个子项的 hitTest 时，也负责转换传给子项的位置。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hit.4: 如果需要进行变换，子类必须调用 BoxHitTestResult.addWithPaintTransform、BoxHitTestResult.addWithPaintOffset 或 BoxHitTestResult.addWithRawTransform，以便在 BoxHitTestResult 中记录所需的变换操作。这些方法也会帮助将变换应用到 position。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hit.5: 此方法由 hitTest 使用。如果重写 hitTest 时不调用此函数，则无需实现此函数。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hor.1: 例如，如果轴方向为 AxisDirection.right，则滚动偏移量为零的位置在视口左侧，并向视口右侧递增。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hor.0: 视口内部内容在水平方向上应显示哪一部分。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/hor.1: ViewportOffset.pixels 的值决定视口使用哪个滚动偏移量来选择并显示内容。用户水平滚动视口时，该值会发生变化，显示的内容也会随之变化。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/las.0: 视口中按照 mainAxis 遍历顺序排列的最后一个子项。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/las.1: mainAxis 会结合每个子项的 ChildVicinity，使子项按行优先或列优先顺序绘制。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/las.2: 默认情况下，mainAxis 为 Axis.vertical，因此采用行优先绘制顺序：先遍历水平方向的索引，再前进到下一个垂直索引。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/las.3: 在 layoutChildSequence 期间，此值为 null，因为布局完成后才会按正确顺序实例化子项。重写 paint 并按正确顺序绘制子项时，可以使用此值。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/lay.1: 子类必须实现此方法，以对视口中的子项进行布局。必须在此方法中设置 TwoDimensionalViewportParentData.layoutOffset，这样绘制时才能正确定位子项。此外，布局视口子项时，必须假定父级（即此视口）会使用子项的尺寸。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/lay.2: 创建和获取子项主要使用 buildOrObtainChildFor。该方法接收一个供 TwoDimensionalChildDelegate 使用的 ChildVicinity。如果 delegate 未为给定 vicinity 提供子项，该方法会返回 null；否则会返回该子项的 RenderBox。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/lay.3: layoutChildSequence 完成后，所有尚未获取的剩余子项都会被释放。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/mai.1: 子类可使用此属性确定绘制顺序、按行优先或列优先排列的访问方式，以及命中测试的优先顺序。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/nee.0: 子类应使用此属性，使 delegate 中的缓存数据失效。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/nee.1: 调用 layoutChildSequence 后，此值会设为 false。如果调用 markNeedsLayout 时将 withDelegateRebuild 设为 true，此值就会更新为 true，表示下一次调用 layoutChildSequence 时需要更新缓存的 delegate 信息。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/nee.2: 子类不一定要使用此值，但可以用它在两次布局调用之间安全地缓存布局信息。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/pai.0: 在给定 context 中的给定偏移处绘制此 render object。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/pai.1: 子类应重写此方法，为自身提供视觉外观。render object 的局部坐标系与 context 的画布坐标系轴向对齐，其局部原点（即 x=0、y=0）位于画布中的给定偏移处。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/pai.2: 不要直接调用此函数。若要绘制自身，请改为调用 markNeedsPaint，以安排此函数的调用。若要绘制子项，请在给定的 context 上调用 PaintingContext.paintChild。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/pai.3: 通过给定 context 上的子项绘制函数绘制子项时，context 当前持有的画布可能会变化，因为子项绘制前后的绘制操作可能需要记录在不同的合成层中。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/par.0: 用于获取并转型视口子项 ParentData 的便捷方法。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/par.1: 子项的 ParentData 必须是 TwoDimensionalViewportParentData 类型或其子类。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.0: 执行此 render object 的布局计算工作。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.1: 不要直接调用此函数，请改为调用 layout。当布局过程中此 render object 确实需要执行工作时，layout 会调用此函数。可通过 constraints getter 获取父级提供的布局约束。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.2: 如果 sizedByParent 为 true，此函数不应更改 render object 的尺寸；应由 performResize 完成此工作。如果 sizedByParent 为 false，此函数则应同时更改 render object 的尺寸，并指示其子项进行布局。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.3: 实现此函数时，必须对每个子项调用 layout。如果布局信息依赖子项的布局信息，则应将 parentUsesSize 设为 true。这样子项发生布局时，此 render object 也会重新布局。否则，子项可以更改自身布局信息而不通知此 render object。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.4: 某些特殊的 RenderObject 子类（例如 OverlayPortal.overlayChildLayoutBuilder 使用的子类）会在其 performLayout 实现中调用 applyPaintTransform。为使这类 RenderObject 获取最新的绘制变换，RenderObject 子类通常应在此方法中更新绘制变换（由 applyPaintTransform 报告），而不是在 paint 中更新。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.0: 仅根据约束更新 render object 的尺寸。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.1: 不要直接调用此函数，请改为调用 layout。当布局过程中此 render object 确实需要执行工作时，layout 会调用此函数。可通过 constraints getter 获取父级提供的布局约束。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.2: 仅当 sizedByParent 为 true 时才会调用此函数。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/per.3: 默认情况下，此方法会将 size 设为使用当前 constraints 调用 computeDryLayout 所得到的结果。建议考虑重写 computeDryLayout，而不是重写此方法。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/red.0: 如果此节点有子项，则调整其子项的 depth。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/red.1: 包含子节点的子类应重写此方法，并为每个子项调用 redepthChild。不要直接调用此方法。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/scr.0: 视口可见区域的前后都有缓存区域，用于缓存用户滚动后即将进入可见区域的条目。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/scr.1: 落在此缓存区域内的条目即使尚未显示在屏幕上，也会进行布局。scrollCacheExtent 描述缓存区域在视口前缘之前和后缘之后延伸的距离。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/scr.2: 视口会尝试用子项覆盖的总范围为：前缘之前的 scrollCacheExtent + 主轴范围 + 后缘之后的 scrollCacheExtent。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/scr.3: 在 iOS 上，缓存区域还用于实现隐式无障碍滚动：当无障碍焦点从可见视口中的条目移动到缓存区域内的不可见条目时，框架会通过（隐式）滚动操作将该条目移入视野。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/set.0: 重写此方法，为子项正确设置 parent data。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/set.1: 可在子项加入父节点的子项列表之前，调用此函数为其设置 parent data。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.0: 通过调整 ViewportOffset，使给定 viewport 中的 descendant（或其一部分）在 viewport 的一个或两个维度上完全可见。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.1: axisDirection 决定要通过哪些轴显示 descendant。如果 axisDirection 为 null，则会同时更新两个轴以显示该后代。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.2: 可选参数 rect 用于描述视口中应显示 descendant 的哪个区域。如果 rect 为 null，则显示整个 descendant。rect 参数采用 descendant 的坐标系。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.3: 返回的 Rect 描述显示完成后，descendant 或 rect 在视口中的新位置。有关此 Rect 的完整定义，请参阅 RevealedOffset.rect。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.4: 必须提供 viewport 参数且其值不能为 null。如果 descendant 为 null，则此方法不执行任何操作，并返回 rect。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.5: 如果 descendant 和 rect 都为 null，则视口中没有要显示的内容，因此返回 null。
widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.6: 可将 duration 设为非零值，以通过由 curve 定义的动画将目标对象移入视口。

widgets/RenderTwoDimensionalViewport/sho.0: 尝试使此 RenderObject 或其后代的（部分）内容在屏幕上可见。

This example shows best practices for implementing debugFillProperties illustrating use of all common DiagnosticsProperty subclasses and all common DiagnosticsProperty parameters.

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

widgets/RootElementMixin/hashCode.html.4: 彼此相等（依据 operator ==）的对象必须具有相同的哈希码。对象的哈希码只应在对象以影响相等性的方式发生变化时才改变。哈希码没有其他要求。它们不需要在程序的多次执行之间保持一致，也没有分布方面的保证。

widgets/Scrollable/debugFillProperties.h.7:
This example shows best practices for implementing debugFillProperties illustrating use of all common DiagnosticsProperty subclasses and all common DiagnosticsProperty parameters.
link 
class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

widgets/Scrollable/dragStartBehavior.htm.0: 决定如何处理拖动手势的起始位置。
widgets/Scrollable/dragStartBehavior.htm.1: 如果设为 DragStartBehavior.start，则滚动拖动会从拖动手势在手势竞争中胜出的位置开始；如果设为 DragStartBehavior.down，则从首次检测到按下事件的位置开始。
widgets/Scrollable/dragStartBehavior.htm.2: 通常，设为 DragStartBehavior.start 会让拖动动画更平滑；设为 DragStartBehavior.down 会让拖动感觉稍微更灵敏。

widgets/Scrollable/ensureVisible.html.0: 滚动所有包含给定上下文的可滚动组件，使该上下文变为可见。
widgets/Scrollable/ensureVisible.html.1: 如果包含所提供 BuildContext 的 Scrollable 是 TwoDimensionalScrollable，则垂直和水平方向都会滚动以确保目标可见。

widgets/Scrollable/excludeFromSemantics..0: 此 Scrollable 引入的滚动操作是否暴露在语义树中。
widgets/Scrollable/excludeFromSemantics..1: 有溢出内容的文本字段通常可以滚动，以确保用户能到达所输入文本的开头或结尾。不过，这类滚动操作通常不会暴露给语义层。

widgets/Scrollable/hitTestBehavior.html.0: 定义此 Scrollable 中手势检测器的行为。
widgets/Scrollable/hitTestBehavior.html.1: 默认值为 HitTestBehavior.opaque，这意味着它会阻止此 Scrollable 后方的目标接收事件。

widgets/Scrollable/incrementCalculator.h.0: 可选函数；当通过键盘使用 ScrollAction 请求滚动时，会调用此函数计算滚动距离。
widgets/Scrollable/incrementCalculator.h.1: 如果未提供此函数，则按下键盘导航键（例如 pageUp/pageDown、control-upArrow 等）或通过 ScrollAction 以其他方式触发滚动时，Scrollable 会滚动默认距离。
widgets/Scrollable/incrementCalculator.h.2: 如果 incrementCalculator 为 null，则 ScrollIncrementType.page 的默认值为滚动窗口尺寸的 80%，而 ScrollIncrementType.line 的默认值为 50 个逻辑像素。

widgets/Scrollable/maybeOf.html.0: 包含给定上下文的最近一个此类实例的状态；如果未找到，则返回 null。
widgets/Scrollable/maybeOf.html.2: 如果存在返回的 ScrollableState，调用此方法会建立对它的依赖。它通常属于最近的 Scrollable，但如果使用 axis 指定目标 Scrollable，也可能属于更远的祖先。
widgets/Scrollable/maybeOf.html.3: 当多个 Scrollable 嵌套且目标 Scrollable 不是最近实例时，可使用可选的 Axis。提供 axis 后，会返回该 Axis 方向上最近的祖先 ScrollableState；如果不存在，则返回 null。
widgets/Scrollable/maybeOf.html.4: 此方法会查找 context 的最近一个祖先 Scrollable。因此，如果 context 属于某个 Scrollable，则不会找到该 Scrollable 组件自身。

widgets/Scrollable/of.html.0: 包含给定上下文的最近一个此类实例的状态。
widgets/Scrollable/of.html.2: 如果存在返回的 ScrollableState，调用此方法会建立对它的依赖。它通常属于最近的 Scrollable，但如果使用 axis 指定目标 Scrollable，也可能属于更远的祖先。
widgets/Scrollable/of.html.3: 当多个 Scrollable 嵌套且目标 Scrollable 不是最近实例时，可使用可选的 Axis。提供 axis 后，会返回该 Axis 方向上最近的祖先 ScrollableState。
widgets/Scrollable/of.html.4: 此方法会查找 context 的最近一个 祖先 Scrollable。因此，如果 context 属于某个 Scrollable，则不会找到该 Scrollable 组件自身。

widgets/Scrollable/physics.html.1: 例如，确定用户停止拖动滚动视图后，组件如何继续动画。
widgets/Scrollable/physics.html.2: 默认根据当前平台约定，使用环境中 ScrollConfiguration 提供的物理特性。
widgets/Scrollable/physics.html.3: 如果为 Scrollable.scrollBehavior 显式提供了 ScrollBehavior，则该行为提供的 ScrollPhysics 会在 Scrollable.physics 之后作为优先选项。
widgets/Scrollable/physics.html.4: 物理特性可以动态更改，但只有所提供对象的类发生变化时，新设置才会生效。仅使用不同配置创建新实例不足以触发物理特性的重新应用。（这是因为最终使用的对象是动态生成的，开销可能较大；如果每帧都推测性地创建该对象以检查是否需要更新物理特性，效率会很低。）

widgets/Scrollable/recommendDeferredLoad.0: 提供一种启发式方法，用于判断在特定时刻是否应为给定 context 延迟执行耗费较大的帧内任务。
widgets/Scrollable/recommendDeferredLoad.1: 调用此方法不会建立对其他组件的依赖。这也意味着返回值只对调用时刻有效；如果该值发生变化，调用方不会收到更新。
widgets/Scrollable/recommendDeferredLoad.2: 此 Scrollable 使用的启发式规则由 physics 决定，具体通过 ScrollPhysics.recommendDeferredLoading 实现。调用时会传入当前 ScrollPosition.activity 的 ScrollActivity.velocity。
widgets/Scrollable/recommendDeferredLoad.3: 可选的 Axis 可用于指定某个方向上的 Scrollable，在多个 Scrollable 嵌套时尤其有用。提供 axis 后，会对该 Axis 方向上最近的 Scrollable 调用 ScrollPosition.recommendDeferredLoading。
widgets/Scrollable/recommendDeferredLoad.4: 如果 context 上方的组件树中没有 Scrollable，此方法返回 false。

widgets/Scrollable/restorationId.html.0: 用于保存和恢复可滚动组件滚动偏移量的恢复 ID。
widgets/Scrollable/restorationId.html.1: 提供恢复 ID 后，可滚动组件会持久化当前滚动偏移量，并在状态恢复时还原该偏移量。
widgets/Scrollable/restorationId.html.2: 滚动偏移量会使用提供的恢复 ID，保存在从周围 RestorationScope 获取的 RestorationBucket 中。

widgets/Scrollable/scrollBehavior.html.1: 默认值为 null；此时会复制继承的 ScrollBehavior 并进行修改，以调整视口装饰，例如添加 Scrollbar。
widgets/Scrollable/scrollBehavior.html.2: ScrollBehavior 也会提供 ScrollPhysics。如果在 physics 中显式提供 ScrollPhysics，则优先使用该值，其次是 scrollBehavior，最后才是继承自祖先的 ScrollBehavior。

widgets/Scrollable/semanticChildCount.ht.0: 将提供语义信息的子项数量。
widgets/Scrollable/semanticChildCount.ht.1: 如果子项数量未知或没有上限，此值为 null。

widgets/Scrollable/semanticChildCount.ht.3: 对于 CustomScrollView 及其他不会接收 builder 或组件列表的类型，必须显式提供子项数量。

widgets/Scrollable/viewportBuilder.html.0: 构建用于显示可滚动内容的视口。
widgets/Scrollable/viewportBuilder.html.1: 典型视口会使用给定的 ViewportOffset，确定内容中哪些部分实际显示在视口内。

widgets/ScrollableDetails/controller.htm.0: 可用于控制此 widget 滚动到何处的对象。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/controller.htm.1: ScrollController 有多种用途。它可以控制初始滚动位置（参阅 ScrollController.initialScrollOffset）；控制滚动视图是否自动在 PageStorage 中保存和恢复滚动位置（参阅 ScrollController.keepScrollOffset）；读取当前滚动位置（参阅 ScrollController.offset），或更改滚动位置（参阅 ScrollController.animateTo）。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/controller.htm.2: 如果为 null，Scrollable 会在内部创建一个 ScrollController，用于创建和管理 ScrollPosition。

widgets/ScrollableDetails/copyWith.html.0: 复制当前 ScrollableDetails，并用给定值替换相应的当前值。

widgets/ScrollableDetails/decorationClip.0: 根据此选项决定是否裁剪内容及如何裁剪。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/decorationClip.1: 有关所有可选值及其常见使用场景，请参阅 Clip 枚举。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/decorationClip.3: 此 Clip 不会影响 Viewport.clipBehavior。Scrollable 会将同一个值传递给装饰组件，使 StretchingOverscrollIndicator 等组件遵循相同的裁剪设置。

widgets/ScrollableDetails/direction.html.1: 例如，如果 Scrollable.axisDirection 为 AxisDirection.down，增大滚动位置会使视口底部之外的内容显示在视口中。同样，如果 axisDirection 为 AxisDirection.right，增大滚动位置会使视口右侧之外的内容显示在视口中。

widgets/ScrollableDetails/hashCode.html.1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/hashCode.html.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 默认实现的哈希码只表示对象的身份；同样，默认的 operator == 实现也只会在两个对象完全相同时才认为它们相等（参阅 identityHashCode）。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/hashCode.html.3: 如果重写 operator ==，改为根据对象状态进行比较，也必须更改哈希码以表示该状态；否则，该对象无法用于基于哈希的集合，例如默认的 Set 和 Map 实现。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/hashCode.html.4: 根据 operator == 判断为相等的对象必须具有相同的哈希码。只有当对象发生影响相等性判断的变化时，其哈希码才应改变。哈希码没有其他要求：不同程序执行之间不必保持一致，也不保证具有特定的分布特性。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/hashCode.html.5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。理论上甚至允许所有实例都使用同一哈希码；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能降低 HashSet 或 HashMap 等基于哈希的数据结构的效率。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/hashCode.html.6: 如果子类重写了 hashCode，也应重写 operator == 运算符，以保持一致。

widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.1: 所有 Object 的默认行为都是：仅当此对象与 other 是同一个对象时才返回 true。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.2: 重写此方法可以为类指定不同的相等关系，但该关系仍必须满足等价关系，也就是说必须满足以下条件：
widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.3: 完备性：对所有参数都必须返回布尔值，且不应抛出异常。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.4: 自反性：对所有对象 o，o == o 都必须为 true。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.5: 对称性：对所有对象 o1 和 o2，o1 == o2 与 o2 == o1 必须同时为 true 或同时为 false。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.6: 传递性：对所有对象 o1、o2 和 o3，若 o1 == o2 且 o2 == o3 为 true，则 o1 == o3 也必须为 true。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.7: 此方法还应随时间保持一致：只有至少一个对象发生更改时，两个对象是否相等才应改变。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/operator_equal.8: 如果子类重写了相等运算符，也应重写 hashCode 方法，以保持一致。

widgets/ScrollableDetails/physics.html.0: widget 对用户输入的响应方式。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/physics.html.1: 例如，它决定用户停止拖动滚动视图后，widget 如何继续执行动画。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/physics.html.2: 默认情况下，会通过当前环境中的 ScrollConfiguration 提供的物理效果遵循平台惯例。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/physics.html.3: 如果向 Scrollable.scrollBehavior 显式提供了 ScrollBehavior，那么该行为提供的 ScrollPhysics 将优先于 Scrollable.physics。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/physics.html.4: 可以动态更改物理效果，但只有提供对象的类发生变化时，新效果才会生效。仅使用不同配置创建一个新实例，并不足以触发物理效果重新应用。（这是因为最终使用的对象会动态生成，开销可能较大；如果每帧都投机性地创建该对象以检查是否需要更新物理效果，效率会很低。）

widgets/ScrollableDetails/toString.html.1: 有些类具有默认的文本表示，通常还提供一个静态 parse 函数（例如 int.parse）。这些类会使用该文本表示作为其字符串表示。
widgets/ScrollableDetails/toString.html.2: 其他类没有程序需要关注的、有实际意义的文本表示。这些类通常会重写 toString，以便在检查对象时提供有用的信息，主要用于调试或日志记录。

widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.0: 描述此 widget 所表示的用户界面部分。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.1: 框架会在多种不同情况下调用此方法。例如：
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.2: 此方法可能每一帧都会被调用，除构建 widget 外不应产生任何副作用。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.3: 框架会将此 widget 下方的子树替换为此方法返回的 widget。根据返回的 widget 是否能够更新现有子树的根节点（由调用 Widget.canUpdate 判定），框架会更新现有子树，或移除它并重新创建子树。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.4: 通常，实现会返回一组新创建的 widget，并根据此 widget 的构造参数、给定的 BuildContext 以及此 State 对象的内部状态进行配置。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.5: 给定的 BuildContext 包含此 widget 在树中构建位置的信息。例如，context 会提供该位置上的继承型 widget 集合。BuildContext 参数始终与此 State 对象的 context 属性相同，并且在此对象的整个生命周期内保持不变。此处重复提供 BuildContext 参数，是为了使此方法与 WidgetBuilder 的签名一致。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.7: 为什么 build 方法位于 State 上，而不是 StatefulWidget 上？
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.8: 将 Widget build(BuildContext context) 方法放在 State 上，而不是将 Widget build(BuildContext context, State state) 方法放在 StatefulWidget 上，可以让开发者在继承 StatefulWidget 时拥有更大的灵活性。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.9: 例如，AnimatedWidget 是 StatefulWidget 的子类，它为子类引入了一个抽象的 Widget build(BuildContext context) 方法供其实现。如果 StatefulWidget 已经有一个 build 方法，该方法接收 State 参数，那么 AnimatedWidget 就不得不向子类提供自己的 State 对象，尽管其 State 对象只是 AnimatedWidget 的内部实现细节。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.10: 从概念上说，StatelessWidget 也可以类似地实现为 StatefulWidget 的子类。如果 build 方法位于 State 上，而不是 StatefulWidget 上，这种实现方式就不再可行。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.11: 将 build 函数放在 State 上而非 StatefulWidget 上，还有助于避免一类与闭包隐式捕获 this 有关的错误。如果在 StatefulWidget 的 build 函数中定义闭包，该闭包会隐式捕获 this（即当前 widget 实例），并能访问此实例不可变的字段：
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.12: 例如，假设父级以蓝色 color 构建 MyButton，那么打印函数中的 $color 会如预期一样指向蓝色。之后，假设父级以绿色重新构建 MyButton。第一次构建时创建的闭包仍会隐式引用原来的 widget，因此 $color 仍会打印蓝色，尽管 widget 已更新为绿色；如果该闭包的生命周期超过了原 widget，它打印的信息就会过时。
widgets/ScrollableState/build.html.13: 相反，如果 build 函数位于 State 对象上，那么在 build 期间创建的闭包会隐式捕获 State 实例，而不是 widget 实例：

此示例展示实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，并演示所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类及所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 参数。
