class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

material/BottomAppBarThemeData/hashCode..1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
material/BottomAppBarThemeData/hashCode..2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 默认实现的哈希码只表示对象的标识；同样，默认的 operator == 实现也只有在两个对象是同一对象时才会认为它们相等（参见 identityHashCode）。
material/BottomAppBarThemeData/hashCode..3: 如果重写 operator ==，使其根据对象状态判断相等性，也必须更改哈希码以表示该状态；否则，该对象就无法正确用于基于哈希的集合，例如默认的 Set 和 Map 实现。
material/BottomAppBarThemeData/hashCode..4: 根据 operator == 判断为相等的对象必须具有相同的哈希码。只有当对象以影响相等性的方式发生变化时，其哈希码才应改变。除此之外，哈希码没有其他要求：同一程序的不同运行之间无需保持一致，也不保证哈希值的分布情况。
material/BottomAppBarThemeData/hashCode..5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。技术上，所有实例都使用相同哈希码也允许；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能会降低基于哈希的数据结构（例如 HashSet 或 HashMap）的效率。
material/BottomAppBarThemeData/hashCode..6: 如果子类重写了 hashCode，也应重写 operator == 运算符，以保持一致。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

此示例展示实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，并演示常见 DiagnosticsProperty 子类和常见 DiagnosticsProperty 参数的用法。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,

material/CardThemeData/hashCode.html.1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
material/CardThemeData/hashCode.html.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 实现的默认哈希码只表示对象的标识；同样，默认的 operator == 实现也只会在两个对象是同一对象时才认为它们相等（参见 identityHashCode）。

material/CarouselView/CarouselView.weigh.4: 假设主轴视口范围为 800，首个条目是条目 0，则三个可见条目的范围分别为 100、600 和 100。条目 0 滚出屏幕时，条目 1 的范围会从 600 平滑缩小到 100。例如，条目 0 有 30% 滚出屏幕时，条目 1 的尺寸应缩小 600 与 100 之差的 30%，即 600 - 0.3 * (600 - 100)。类似地，条目 2 的范围会从 100 增加到 600，即 100 + 0.3 * (600 - 100)。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

此示例展示实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，并演示常见 DiagnosticsProperty 子类及常见 DiagnosticsProperty 参数的用法。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

material/CheckboxThemeData/hashCode.html.1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
material/CheckboxThemeData/hashCode.html.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 实现的默认哈希码只表示对象的标识；同样，默认的 operator == 实现也只会在两个对象是同一对象时才认为它们相等（参见 identityHashCode）。
material/CheckboxThemeData/hashCode.html.3: 如果重写 operator ==，使其根据对象状态进行比较，也必须修改哈希码以表示该状态；否则，该对象无法用于默认的 Set 和 Map 等基于哈希的数据结构。
material/CheckboxThemeData/hashCode.html.4: 根据 operator == 判断为相等的对象必须具有相同的哈希码。只有当对象发生影响相等性判断的变化时，其哈希码才应改变。除此之外，哈希码没有其他要求：同一程序的不同次运行之间无需保持一致，也不保证哈希值的分布方式。
material/CheckboxThemeData/hashCode.html.5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。理论上甚至允许所有实例都使用同一哈希码；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能降低 HashSet 或 HashMap 等基于哈希的数据结构的效率。
material/CheckboxThemeData/hashCode.html.6: 如果子类重写了 hashCode，也应重写 operator == 运算符，以保持一致性。

以下示例展示了实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，其中演示了所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类以及所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 参数。
link 
class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

class Wood extends StatefulWidget {
  const Wood({super.key});

  @override
  State<StatefulWidget> createState() => WoodState();
}

class WoodState extends State<Wood> {
  bool _useChisel = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return InputChip(
      label: const Text('Use Chisel'),
      selected: _useChisel,
      onSelected: (bool newValue) {
        setState(() {
          _useChisel = newValue;
        });
      },
    );
  }
}

material/CircularProgressIndicator/strok.1: 此属性决定进度指示器描边端点的形状。默认情况下，strokeCap 为 null。当 value 为 null（不确定进度）时，端点设为 StrokeCap.square；当 value 非 null 时，端点设为 StrokeCap.butt。

此示例展示了实现 debugFillProperties 并演示所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类，以及所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 参数。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

material/DataRow/onSelectChanged.html.2: 只要存在可选择的行，表格标题行就会显示一个复选框，可用于选中所有可选择的行；当所有行都已选中时，该复选框也会呈选中状态。之后的每一行都会显示一个复选框，用于切换该行的选中状态。
material/DataRow/onSelectChanged.html.3: 如果某行的 onSelectChanged 回调为 null，则确定“全选”复选框状态时会忽略该行，并且该行的复选框会被禁用。
material/DataRow/onSelectChanged.html.4: 如果该行中的某个 DataCell 定义了 DataCell.onTap 回调，则该回调行为会覆盖该单元格原本采用的行手势行为。

material/DataRow/selected.html.1: 如果表格中任意一行的 onSelectChanged 非 null，则每行开头都会显示复选框。行处于选中状态（true）时，复选框会被勾选，并高亮显示该行。
material/DataRow/selected.html.2: 否则，即使显示复选框，也不会将其勾选。

material/DataTable/border.html.0: 绘制表格外边界和内部网格线时使用的样式。

material/DataTable/build.html.0: 描述此 widget 所表示的用户界面部分。
material/DataTable/build.html.1: 当此 widget 在给定的 BuildContext 中插入树中，以及此 widget 的依赖项发生变化时（例如它引用的 InheritedWidget 发生变化时），框架会调用此方法。此方法可能在每一帧中调用，除了构建 widget 之外不应产生任何副作用。
material/DataTable/build.html.2: 框架会将此 widget 下方的子树替换为此方法返回的 widget。根据返回的 widget 是否能够更新现有子树的根节点（由调用 Widget.canUpdate 判定），框架会更新现有子树，或移除它并重新创建子树。
material/DataTable/build.html.3: 通常，实现会返回一组新创建的 widget，并根据此 widget 的构造函数信息和给定的 BuildContext 配置这些 widget。
material/DataTable/build.html.4: 给定的 BuildContext 包含此 widget 在树中构建位置的信息。例如，context 会提供该位置可继承的 widget 集合。如果 widget 在树中移动，或同时插入多个位置，同一个 widget 随时间推移可能会使用多个不同的 BuildContext 参数进行构建。
material/DataTable/build.html.6: 如果组件的 build 方法需要依赖其他内容，请改用 StatefulWidget。

material/DataTable/checkboxHorizontalMar.0: 显示复选框时，其周围的水平边距。
material/DataTable/checkboxHorizontalMar.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.checkboxHorizontalMargin。如果该值也为 null，则使用 horizontalMargin 作为表格边缘与复选框之间，以及复选框与第一列内容之间的边距。默认值为 24.0。

material/DataTable/clipBehavior.html.0: 根据此选项决定是否裁剪内容及如何裁剪。
material/DataTable/clipBehavior.html.1: 有关所有可选值及其常见使用场景，请参阅 Clip 枚举。
material/DataTable/clipBehavior.html.2: 可使用此属性将内容裁剪到 DataTable 的边框范围内。

material/DataTable/columnSpacing.html.0: 各数据列内容之间的水平间距。
material/DataTable/columnSpacing.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.columnSpacing。为符合 Material Design 规范，默认值为 56.0。

material/DataTable/dataRowColor.html.1: 最终背景颜色可以根据 WidgetState 状态确定，例如行是否处于选中、按下、悬停、聚焦、禁用或启用状态。该颜色会作为叠加层绘制在行上。为确保行的 InkWell 在按下、悬停和聚焦时仍可见，建议使用半透明背景色。
material/DataTable/dataRowColor.html.2: 如果 DataRow.onSelectChanged 或 DataRow.onLongPress 为 null，则行的 InkWell 会被禁用。
material/DataTable/dataRowColor.html.3: 如果为 null，则使用 DataTableThemeData.dataRowColor。默认情况下，未选中行的背景色为透明；选中行则显示半透明灰色。若要为各行单独设置不同颜色，请参阅 DataRow.color。

material/DataTable/dataRowHeight.html.0: 每行的高度（不包括列标题所在行）。
material/DataTable/dataRowHeight.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.dataRowHeight。为符合 Material Design 规范，默认值为 kMinInteractiveDimension。

material/DataTable/dataRowMaxHeight.html.0: 每行的最大高度（不包括列标题所在行）。
material/DataTable/dataRowMaxHeight.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.dataRowMaxHeight。为符合 Material Design 规范，默认值为 kMinInteractiveDimension。

material/DataTable/dataRowMinHeight.html.0: 每行的最小高度（不包括列标题所在行）。
material/DataTable/dataRowMinHeight.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.dataRowMinHeight。为符合 Material Design 规范，默认值为 kMinInteractiveDimension。

material/DataTable/DataTable.html.0: 创建一个用于描述数据表格的组件。
material/DataTable/DataTable.html.1: columns 参数必须是一个列表，其中包含与表格列数相同数量的 DataColumn 对象；如有前置复选框列，则不计入列数。columns 参数的列表长度必须大于零。
material/DataTable/DataTable.html.2: rows 参数必须是一个列表，其中包含与表格行数相同数量的 DataRow 对象；包含列标题的前置标题行（由 columns 参数生成）不计入行数。列表可以为空，但 rows 参数不得为 null。
material/DataTable/DataTable.html.3: rows 中的每个 DataRow 对象，其 DataRow.cells 列表都必须包含与表格列数相同数量的 DataCell 对象。
material/DataTable/DataTable.html.4: 如果表格已排序，应通过索引在 sortColumnIndex 中指定当前主排序键所在列：0 表示第一列（位于 columns 中），1 表示下一列，依此类推。
material/DataTable/DataTable.html.5: 可以使用 sortAscending 指定实际排序方向；升序时设为 true（默认值），否则设为 false。

material/DataTable/dataTextStyle.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.dataTextStyle。默认文本样式为 TextTheme.bodyMedium。

material/DataTable/decoration.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.decoration。默认不添加装饰。

material/DataTable/dividerThickness.html.2: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.dividerThickness。默认值为 1.0。

material/DataTable/headingRowColor.html.1: 最终背景颜色可以根据 WidgetState 状态确定，例如该行是否在排序时处于按下、悬停或聚焦状态。颜色会作为叠加层绘制在行上。为确保行的 InkWell 在按下、悬停和聚焦时仍可见，建议使用半透明颜色。

material/DataTable/headingRowHeight.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.headingRowHeight。为符合 Material Design 规范，默认值为 56.0。

material/DataTable/headingTextStyle.html.1: 为 null 时使用 DataTableThemeData.headingTextStyle。默认文本样式为 TextTheme.titleSmall。

material/DataTable/horizontalMargin.html.0: 每行第一个和最后一个单元格的内容与表格边缘之间的水平边距。
material/DataTable/horizontalMargin.html.1: 显示复选框时，该值也表示复选框与第一个数据列内容之间的边距。
material/DataTable/horizontalMargin.html.2: 如果为 null，则使用 DataTableThemeData.horizontalMargin。为符合 Material Design 规范，此值默认为 24.0。
material/DataTable/horizontalMargin.html.3: 如果 checkboxHorizontalMargin 为 null，则 horizontalMargin 同时作为表格边缘与复选框之间、以及复选框与第一个数据列内容之间的边距。

material/DataTable/onSelectAll.html.0: 用户通过标题行中的复选框选择或取消选择所有行时调用。
material/DataTable/onSelectAll.html.1: 如果此值为 null，则会改为对表格中的每一行适当地调用 DataRow.onSelectChanged 回调。
material/DataTable/onSelectAll.html.2: 如需控制某一行是否可选，请参阅 DataRow.onSelectChanged。只有存在可选行时，此回调才有意义。

material/DataTable/rows.html.0: 每一行要显示的数据（不包括包含列标题的行）。

material/DataTable/showBottomBorder.html.1: 默认不显示底部边框，以便通过 decoration 为表格定义外边框。

material/DataTable/showCheckboxColumn.ht.0: 是否为可选择的行显示复选框。
material/DataTable/showCheckboxColumn.ht.1: 设为 true 时，每个可选择行的开头都会放置一个 Checkbox。但如果没有任何行设置 DataRow.onSelectChanged，即使此值为 true，也不会显示复选框。
material/DataTable/showCheckboxColumn.ht.2: 设为 false 时，所有行都不会显示 Checkbox。

material/DataTable/sortAscending.html.0: sortColumnIndex 指定的列（如果有）是否按升序排列。
material/DataTable/sortAscending.html.1: 为 true 时按升序排列，即当前排序列中值最小的行显示在表格前面。
material/DataTable/sortAscending.html.2: 为 false 时按降序排列，即当前排序列中值最小的行显示在表格末尾。

material/DataTable/sortColumnIndex.html.1: 非 null 时表示数据按指定列排序。此值必须是该列在 columns 中的索引。
material/DataTable/sortColumnIndex.html.2: 设置此值后，相应列会显示排序指示器。
material/DataTable/sortColumnIndex.html.3: 此值为 null 时，表示表格的排序顺序与任何列都不对应。

material/DataTableSource/getRow.html.0: 调用此方法以获取特定行的数据。
material/DataTableSource/getRow.html.1: 行应设置稳定的键，以便数据源排序时仍能保留状态（例如响应 DataColumn.onSort 时）。无论排序顺序如何，同一个 DataRow 都应使用一致的键（即键表示数据的身份，而不是行的位置）。
material/DataTableSource/getRow.html.2: DataRow.byIndex 构造函数可方便地创建此方法所需的 DataRow 对象，无需为每一行单独设置键。传给该构造函数的索引是底层数据的索引，与 getRow 的 index 参数不同；后者表示排序后的位置。
material/DataTableSource/getRow.html.3: 如果给定索引没有对应的行，或者该行的数据尚不可用，则返回 null。此时该行会留空，并在表格上显示加载指示器。数据可用后，或者确认该行索引已超出表格范围后，调用 notifyListeners。（参见 rowCount。）

material/DataTableSource/isRowCountAppro.0: 调用此方法以确定 rowCount 是精确值还是估算值。如果返回 true（即行数为估算值），之后获得精确数量时应调用 notifyListeners。

material/DataTableSource/rowCount.html.0: 调用此方法以获取并告知用户当前可用的行数。
material/DataTableSource/rowCount.html.1: 如果 isRowCountApproximate 为 false，则此值必须准确，并且对于从 0 到行数减 1 范围内的所有索引，getRow 都必须返回非 null 值。
material/DataTableSource/rowCount.html.2: 如果 isRowCountApproximate 为 true，用户可以尝试显示到此 rowCount 范围内的行，界面也会提示该数量为估算值。因此，尽可能让行数大于实际行数。

material/DataTableSource/selectedRowCoun.0: 调用此方法以获取当前选中的行数。
material/DataTableSource/selectedRowCoun.2: 当 DataRow.selected 属性为 true 时，该行即为选中行。

material/DataTableTheme/data.html.0: 应用于所有后代 DataTable 控件的属性。

material/DataTableTheme/DataTableTheme.h.0: 创建数据表主题，用于配置所有后代 DataTable 控件。

material/DataTableTheme/of.html.0: 返回最近的 DataTableTheme 祖先中的配置 data。如果没有祖先，则返回 ThemeData.dataTableTheme。应用可以假定返回值不会为 null。

material/DataTableTheme/updateShouldNoti.0: 框架是否应通知继承此组件的组件。
material/DataTableTheme/updateShouldNoti.1: 此组件重新构建时，有时需要重新构建继承它的组件，有时则不需要。例如，如果此组件持有的数据与 oldWidget 持有的数据相同，就无需重新构建继承 oldWidget 数据的组件。
material/DataTableTheme/updateShouldNoti.2: 框架通过调用此函数来区分这些情况，并将此前占据组件树中此位置的组件作为参数传入。传入组件的 runtimeType 保证与此对象相同。

material/DataTableThemeData/columnSpacin.0: 各数据列内容之间的水平间距。

material/DataTableThemeData/copyWith.htm.0: 创建此对象的副本，并用新值替换指定字段。

material/DataTableThemeData/dataRowColor.1: 最终背景颜色可以根据 WidgetState 状态确定，例如行是否处于选中、按下、悬停、聚焦、禁用或启用状态。颜色会作为叠加层绘制在行上。为确保行的 InkWell 在按下、悬停和聚焦时仍可见，建议使用半透明背景色。
material/DataTableThemeData/dataRowColor.2: 如果 DataRow.onSelectChanged 或 DataRow.onLongPress 为 null，则行的 InkWell 会被禁用。

material/DataTableThemeData/dataRowCurso.0: 如果指定，则覆盖 DataRow.mouseCursor 的默认值。

material/DataTableThemeData/dataRowHeigh.0: 每行的高度（不包括列标题所在行）。

material/DataTableThemeData/dataRowMaxHe.0: 每行的最大高度（不包括列标题所在行）。

material/DataTableThemeData/dataRowMinHe.0: 每行的最小高度（不包括列标题所在行）。

material/DataTableThemeData/debugFillPro.0: 为此节点添加其他相关属性。
material/DataTableThemeData/debugFillPro.1: 描述每个属性时，应使用现有且最具体的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类，而不是 DiagnosticsProperty 基类。DiagnosticsProperty 子类数量不多，分别覆盖常见用途。请考虑哪些属性值对调试用户有帮助，因为调试大型树时信息过多会增加负担。DiagnosticsNode 子类中的常用命名参数有助于筛选属性的显示时机和方式。
material/DataTableThemeData/debugFillPro.2: defaultValue、showName、showSeparator 和 level 可以让诊断信息的字符串表示保持简洁，并在属性用处不大时将其隐藏。
material/DataTableThemeData/debugFillPro.3: ifNull、ifEmpty、unit 和 tooltip 可以让属性说明更清楚。下面代码示例展示了这些参数的良好用法。
material/DataTableThemeData/debugFillPro.4: 用于基本类型的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类
material/DataTableThemeData/debugFillPro.6: 如果这些子类都不适用，可以直接使用 DiagnosticsProperty 构造函数；少数情况下，也可以像 TransformProperty 那样创建自己的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类，以处理表示变换的 Matrix4。通常，只要属性值实现了良好的 toString 方法，直接使用 DiagnosticsProperty 就可以正常工作。

此示例展示了实现 debugFillProperties 并演示所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类，以及所有常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 参数。
link 
class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}
material/DataTableThemeData/debugFillPro.9: 不要添加生命周期短于此对象的值。

material/DataTableThemeData/hashCode.htm.1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
material/DataTableThemeData/hashCode.htm.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 实现的默认哈希码只表示对象的标识；默认的 operator == 也只在对象相同时才判定它们相等（参见 identityHashCode）。
material/DataTableThemeData/hashCode.htm.3: 如果重写 operator ==，使其根据对象状态判断相等，也必须修改哈希码以表示该状态；否则，该对象不能用于默认 Set 和 Map 等基于哈希的数据结构。
material/DataTableThemeData/hashCode.htm.4: 根据 operator == 判定相等的对象必须具有相同哈希码。对象状态只有在影响相等性时发生变化，哈希码才应随之变化。除此之外没有其他要求：哈希码不必在同一程序的多次运行间保持一致，也不保证分布特性。
material/DataTableThemeData/hashCode.htm.5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。理论上甚至允许所有实例都使用同一哈希码；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能降低 HashSet 或 HashMap 等基于哈希的数据结构的效率。
material/DataTableThemeData/hashCode.htm.6: 如果子类重写了 hashCode，也应重写 operator ==，以保持一致。

material/DataTableThemeData/headingCellC.0: 如果指定，则覆盖 DataColumn.mouseCursor 的默认值。

material/DataTableThemeData/headingRowAl.0: 如果指定，则覆盖 DataColumn.headingRowAlignment 的默认值。

material/DataTableThemeData/headingRowCo.1: 最终背景颜色可以根据 WidgetState 状态确定，例如该行是否在排序时处于按下、悬停或聚焦状态。颜色会作为叠加层绘制在行上。为确保行的 InkWell 在按下、悬停和聚焦时仍可见，建议使用半透明颜色。

material/DataTableThemeData/horizontalMa.0: 每行首尾单元格内容与表格边缘之间的水平边距。
material/DataTableThemeData/horizontalMa.1: 显示复选框时，此值也表示复选框与第一列数据内容之间的边距。

material/DataTableThemeData/lerp.html.0: 在两个 DataTableThemeData 对象之间进行线性插值。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

material/DateTimeRange/hashCode.html.1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
material/DateTimeRange/hashCode.html.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 默认实现的哈希码只表示对象标识；同样，operator == 默认实现也只在两个对象完全相同时才认为它们相等（参见 identityHashCode）。
material/DateTimeRange/hashCode.html.3: 如果重写 operator ==，使其根据对象状态判断相等，也必须修改哈希码以表示该状态。否则，此对象无法用于默认 Set 和 Map 等基于哈希的集合结构。
material/DateTimeRange/hashCode.html.4: 根据 operator == 判断相等的对象必须具有相同的哈希码。只有当对象发生影响相等判断的变化时，其哈希码才应变化。除此之外没有其他要求；同一程序的不同次运行不必得到一致的哈希码，也不保证哈希值的分布情况。
material/DateTimeRange/hashCode.html.5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。理论上，所有实例都可以使用相同的哈希码；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能会降低 HashSet 或 HashMap 等基于哈希的数据结构的效率。
material/DateTimeRange/hashCode.html.6: 如果子类重写了 hashCode，也应重写 operator ==，以保持一致性。

material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.1: 所有 Object 的默认行为是：仅当此对象与 other 是同一个对象时才返回 true。
material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.2: 重写此方法可为类指定不同的相等关系。重写后的方法仍必须满足等价关系，也就是说，它必须具备以下性质：
material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.3: 完全性：对所有参数都必须返回布尔值，且不应抛出异常。
material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.4: 自反性：对所有对象 o，o == o 都必须为 true。
material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.5: 对称性：对所有对象 o1 和 o2，o1 == o2 与 o2 == o1 必须同时为 true 或同时为 false。
material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.6: 传递性：对所有对象 o1、o2 和 o3，如果 o1 == o2 且 o2 == o3 为 true，则 o1 == o3 也必须为 true。
material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.7: 此方法还应随时间保持一致；只有至少一个对象发生修改时，两个对象是否相等才应改变。
material/DateTimeRange/operator_equals.h.8: 如果子类重写了相等运算符，也应重写 hashCode 方法，以保持一致性。

此处使用 PageRouteBuilder 演示 buildTransitions 方法。覆盖 buildTransitions 方法时，其主体也应以相同方式定义。 link 

PageRouteBuilder<void>(
  pageBuilder: (BuildContext context,
      Animation<double> animation,
      Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
  ) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Hello')),
      body: const Center(
        child: Text('Hello World'),
      ),
    );
  },
  transitionsBuilder: (
      BuildContext context,
      Animation<double> animation,
      Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
      Widget child,
   ) {
    return SlideTransition(
      position: Tween<Offset>(
        begin: const Offset(0.0, 1.0),
        end: Offset.zero,
      ).animate(animation),
      child: child, // child is the value returned by pageBuilder
    );
  },
)
material/DialogRoute/buildTransitions.ht.6: 当 Navigator 将路由推入堆栈顶端时，可以使用 secondaryAnimation 定义原先位于堆栈顶部的路由如何离开屏幕。同样，弹出顶层路由时，可以用它定义下方路由如何重新显示。推入新路由时，旧顶层路由的 secondaryAnimation 会从 0.0 运行到 1.0；弹出顶层路由时，下方路由的 secondaryAnimation 会从 1.0 运行到 0.0。
material/DialogRoute/buildTransitions.ht.7:
以下示例添加了由 secondaryAnimation 驱动的转场。当新路由被推入其上方而导致当前路由消失时，当前路由会朝新路由的相反方向移动。同样，弹出顶层路由使当前路由重新显示时，也会发生相应转场。

PageRouteBuilder<void>(
  pageBuilder: (BuildContext context,
      Animation<double> animation,
      Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
  ) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Hello')),
      body: const Center(
        child: Text('Hello World'),
      ),
    );
  },
  transitionsBuilder: (
      BuildContext context,
      Animation<double> animation,
      Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,
      Widget child,
  ) {
    return SlideTransition(
      position: Tween<Offset>(
        begin: const Offset(0.0, 1.0),
        end: Offset.zero,
      ).animate(animation),
      child: SlideTransition(
        position: Tween<Offset>(
          begin: Offset.zero,
          end: const Offset(0.0, 1.0),
        ).animate(secondaryAnimation),
        child: child,
      ),
     );
  },
)

此示例展示了实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，演示如何使用常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类及其常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 个参数。

class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

material/DialogThemeData/hashCode.html.1: 哈希码是一个整数，用于表示会影响 operator == 比较结果的对象状态。
material/DialogThemeData/hashCode.html.2: 所有对象都有哈希码。Object 默认实现的哈希码只表示对象标识；同样，默认的 operator == 实现只有在对象完全相同时才会判定它们相等（参见 identityHashCode）。
material/DialogThemeData/hashCode.html.3: 如果重写 operator == 以比较对象状态，也必须相应修改哈希码来表示该状态，否则对象无法用于基于哈希的集合，例如默认的 Set 和 Map 实现。
material/DialogThemeData/hashCode.html.4: 根据 operator == 判定为相等的对象必须具有相同的哈希码。只有当对象发生影响相等性的变化时，其哈希码才应改变。除此之外，哈希码没有其他要求。
material/DialogThemeData/hashCode.html.5: 不相等的对象可以具有相同的哈希码。理论上甚至允许所有实例都使用同一哈希码；但如果冲突过于频繁，可能降低 HashSet 或 HashMap 等基于哈希的数据结构的效率。

此示例展示了实现 debugFillProperties 的最佳实践，演示如何使用常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 子类及其常见的 DiagnosticsProperty 个参数。
link 
class ExampleObject extends ExampleSuperclass {

  // ...various members and properties...

  @override
  void debugFillProperties(DiagnosticPropertiesBuilder properties) {
    // Always add properties from the base class first.
    super.debugFillProperties(properties);

    // Omit the property name 'message' when displaying this String property
    // as it would just add visual noise.
    properties.add(StringProperty('message', message, showName: false));

    properties.add(DoubleProperty('stepWidth', stepWidth));

    // A scale of 1.0 does nothing so should be hidden.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('scale', scale, defaultValue: 1.0));

    // If the hitTestExtent matches the paintExtent, it is just set to its
    // default value so is not relevant.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('hitTestExtent', hitTestExtent, defaultValue: paintExtent));

    // maxWidth of double.infinity indicates the width is unconstrained and
    // so maxWidth has no impact.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty('maxWidth', maxWidth, defaultValue: double.infinity));

    // Progress is a value between 0 and 1 or null. Showing it as a
    // percentage makes the meaning clear enough that the name can be
    // hidden.
    properties.add(PercentProperty(
      'progress',
      progress,
      showName: false,
      ifNull: '<indeterminate>',
    ));

    // Most text fields have maxLines set to 1.
    properties.add(IntProperty('maxLines', maxLines, defaultValue: 1));

    // Specify the unit as otherwise it would be unclear that time is in
    // milliseconds.
    properties.add(IntProperty('duration', duration.inMilliseconds, unit: 'ms'));

    // Tooltip is used instead of unit for this case as a unit should be a
    // terse description appropriate to display directly after a number
    // without a space.
    properties.add(DoubleProperty(
      'device pixel ratio',
      devicePixelRatio,
      tooltip: 'physical pixels per logical pixel',
    ));

    // Displaying the depth value would be distracting. Instead only display
    // if the depth value is missing.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<int>('depth', depth, ifNull: 'no depth'));

    // bool flag that is only shown when the value is true.
    properties.add(FlagProperty('using primary controller', value: primary));

    properties.add(FlagProperty(
      'isCurrent',
      value: isCurrent,
      ifTrue: 'active',
      ifFalse: 'inactive',
    ));

    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('keepAlive', keepAlive));

    // FlagProperty could have also been used in this case.
    // This option results in the text "obscureText: true" instead
    // of "obscureText" which is a bit more verbose but a bit clearer.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<bool>('obscureText', obscureText, defaultValue: false));

    properties.add(EnumProperty<TextAlign>('textAlign', textAlign, defaultValue: null));
    properties.add(EnumProperty<ImageRepeat>('repeat', repeat, defaultValue: ImageRepeat.noRepeat));

    // Warn users when the widget is missing but do not show the value.
    properties.add(ObjectFlagProperty<Widget>('widget', widget, ifNull: 'no widget'));

    properties.add(IterableProperty<BoxShadow>(
      'boxShadow',
      boxShadow,
      defaultValue: null,
      style: style,
    ));

    // Getting the value of size throws an exception unless hasSize is true.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Size>.lazy(
      'size',
      () => size,
      description: '${ hasSize ? size : "MISSING" }',
    ));

    // If the `toString` method for the property value does not provide a
    // good terse description, write a DiagnosticsProperty subclass as in
    // the case of TransformProperty which displays a nice debugging view
    // of a Matrix4 that represents a transform.
    properties.add(TransformProperty('transform', transform));

    // If the value class has a good `toString` method, use
    // DiagnosticsProperty<YourValueType>. Specifying the value type ensures
    // that debugging tools always know the type of the field and so can
    // provide the right UI affordances. For example, in this case even
    // if color is null, a debugging tool still knows the value is a Color
    // and can display relevant color related UI.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Color>('color', color));

    // Use a custom description to generate a more terse summary than the
    // `toString` method on the map class.
    properties.add(DiagnosticsProperty<Map<Listenable, VoidCallback>>(
      'handles',
      handles,
      description: handles != null
        ? '${handles!.length} active client${ handles!.length == 1 ? "" : "s" }'
        : null,
      ifNull: 'no notifications ever received',
      showName: false,
    ));
  }
}

material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.7: 为什么将 build 方法放在 State 上，而不是 StatefulWidget 上？
material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.8: 将 Widget build(BuildContext context) 方法放在 State 上，而不是在 StatefulWidget 上定义 Widget build(BuildContext context, State state) 方法并传入 State 参数，这会让开发者在继承 StatefulWidget 时拥有更大的灵活性。
material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.9: 例如，AnimatedWidget 是 StatefulWidget 的子类，它引入了抽象的 Widget build(BuildContext context) 方法供其子类实现。如果 StatefulWidget 已经有一个接收 State 参数的 build 方法，那么 AnimatedWidget 也不得不将其 State 对象提供给子类，尽管该 State 对象只是 AnimatedWidget 的内部实现细节。
material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.10: 从概念上说，也可以用类似方式将 StatelessWidget 实现为 StatefulWidget 的子类。如果把 build 方法放在 StatefulWidget 而不是 State 上，就无法再这样实现。
material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.11: 将 build 函数放在 State 而不是 StatefulWidget 上，也有助于避免闭包隐式捕获 this 所导致的一类错误。如果在 StatefulWidget 上定义的 build 函数中创建闭包，该闭包会隐式捕获 this（也就是当前小组件实例），并能访问该实例不可变的字段：
material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.12: 例如，假设父组件以蓝色构建 MyButton，打印函数中的 $color 会如预期那样表示蓝色（其值来自 color）。随后，父组件以绿色重建 MyButton。第一次构建时创建的闭包仍隐式引用原始小组件，因此即使小组件已更新为绿色，$color 仍会打印蓝色；如果该闭包的生命周期长于小组件，它打印的就会是过时信息。
material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.13: 相较之下，将 build 函数放在 State 对象上时，build 过程中创建的闭包会隐式捕获 State 实例，而不是小组件实例：
material/DrawerControllerState/build.htm.14: 现在，父组件以绿色重建 MyButton 时，第一次构建所创建的闭包仍引用跨重建而保留的 State 对象；但框架已将该 State 对象的 widget 属性更新为指向新的 MyButton 实例，因此 ${widget.color} 会如预期打印绿色。
